additions.description: Private user creation endpoint allows clients to set is_active and is_superuser in the request body
additions.reasoning: The specification requires a private user creation operation and verifies fields like email, id, and is_active in responses, but it does not state that callers may supply is_active or is_superuser values. The code exposes both as writable input fields on POST /api/v1/users/.

additions.description: Superuser item listing is returned with a top-level data/count wrapper rather than as a plain collection
additions.reasoning: The specification for listing items only requires that the returned data contain at least the created items. It does not positively require a wrapper object with data and count fields, but the code always returns ItemsPublic with those top-level fields.

omissions.description: Missing test-token endpoint required by the authentication specification
omissions.reasoning: The specification explicitly requires 'use this access token to call the test token endpoint' and expects a 200 response containing the field email='admin@example.com'. The code defines no such endpoint under /api/v1/.

omissions.description: Missing password recovery request endpoint POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email}
omissions.reasoning: The specification explicitly requires requesting a password recovery email via POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email}. No password-recovery route exists in the code.

The specification explicitly requires submitting a password reset request with token and new_password to the reset-password operation and checking both success and invalid-token behavior. The code has no reset-password endpoint.

omissions.description: Password recovery flow does not send an email and does not interact with the mailcatcher service
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that password recovery send an email and that it be verifiable via GET http://localhost:1080/messages. The code contains no outbound email or mailcatcher interaction at all.

omissions.description: No implementation of password recovery token generation, retrieval of password-recovery HTML content, or token-based password reset
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires generating a reset token, obtaining password-recovery HTML content for a user's email, resetting the password with that token, returning {"message": "Password updated successfully"} on success, and returning 400 detail 'Invalid token' for an invalid token. None of this token-based recovery/reset logic exists in the code.
